recipes.name: Chicken Wings
recipes.prep: Season wings with salt and pepper and bake or fry until crispy. Melt butter and mix with hot sauce. Toss wings in sauce until fully coated and serve hot.

recipes.name: Chicken Tenders
recipes.prep: Season chicken. Dredge in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then coat with breadcrumbs. Fry until golden brown and cooked through.

recipes.name: French Fries
recipes.prep: Cut potatoes into strips. Fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Drain and season with salt.

recipes.name: Mozzarella Sticks
recipes.prep: Dip mozzarella sticks in egg, then breadcrumbs. Freeze briefly, then fry until golden. Serve with marinara sauce.

recipes.name: Onion Rings
recipes.prep: Slice onions, coat in batter and breadcrumbs, then fry until crispy.

recipes.name: Corn Dogs
recipes.prep: Dip hot dogs in batter and fry until golden brown.

recipes.name: Chicken Wrap
recipes.prep: Fill tortillas with chicken and toppings. Roll tightly and serve.

recipes.name: Tacos
recipes.prep: Cook beef with seasoning. Fill shells with beef and toppings.

recipes.name: Quesadillas
recipes.prep: Fill tortillas with cheese and cook on skillet until melted. Cut into wedges.

recipes.name: Nachos
recipes.prep: Layer chips with toppings and bake until cheese melts.

recipes.name: Egg Rolls
recipes.prep: Fill wrappers with mixture, roll tightly, and fry until golden.

recipes.name: Spring Rolls
recipes.prep: Soften wrappers, fill with ingredients, and roll. Serve fresh.

recipes.name: Sliders
recipes.prep: Form small patties and cook on skillet or grill. Place on buns with cheese and desired toppings.

recipes.name: Pizza Slices
recipes.prep: Prepare pizza, bake, and slice into handheld pieces.
